title: Two faces of one quotient: orbit-descent (kernel) and audit-DPI (monotonicity) on a single finite deterministic coarse-graining map

card.one_sentence_claim: A single finite deterministic coarse-graining/quotient map q induces two linked, certified constraints on its definability algebra Sigma_q -- orbit-descent (an observable survives q iff it is fiber-constant/q-invariant: gauge/superselection/conserved quantities) and audit-DPI monotonicity (q cannot increase the KL/TV/relative-entropy audit: A(q_# mu, q_# mu') <= A(mu, mu')) -- so "redundancy elimination by quotient" and "no false arrows / no signalling under coarse-graining" are the kernel and the monotonicity of the SAME map; one leg (classical KL-DPI) is a rigid deductive theorem, but the "two faces of one q" link is currently NAMING until the commutative-subalgebra corollary is written.
domains_unified: QM (gauge/superselection invariance + quantum relative-entropy DPI + no-signalling as marginal invariance)
Thermodynamics/NESM (no-false-arrow under coarse-graining: macro path-KL arrow <= micro arrow)
Information theory (classical deterministic finite path-space KL/TV data-processing inequality)
card.argument_family: symmetry-unification (orbit-descent kernel + audit-DPI monotonicity as two structures on one quotient map)
card.shared_mechanism: One finite deterministic surjective lens/quotient q:Z->X carries TWO certified structures simultaneously on its definability algebra Sigma_q: (a) its KERNEL = the descent biconditional (a readout h survives/descends through q iff h is constant on the fibers of q iff h = h_bar o q), which is exactly the q-invariant subalgebra (gauge/superselection/conserved observables); and (b) its MONOTONICITY = the audit contract (the pushforward q_# is a deterministic channel, so any monotone divergence A satisfies A(q_# mu, q_# mu') <= A(mu, mu') by the log-sum/DPI argument). Invariance is 'what lies in ker-direction of q (descends)'; DPI-monotonicity is 'what cannot grow along q'. The same partition Pi_q that defines fiber-constancy (the kernel) is the partition along which the divergence contracts (the monotone). The proposed unifying object is q itself: descent governs WHICH functions are observable post-q, audit-DPI governs that q cannot CREATE distinguishability/arrow. The quantum face (relative-entropy DPI under CPTP via diagonal-subalgebra restriction) and the no-signalling face (marginal invariance under a remote setting) are the operator-algebra and tensor-marginal specializations of the same q-monotonicity-plus-q-invariance pair.
